items.title: SESSION-END RE-MEASUREMENT (review-ajcr r6 close). The count moved AGAIN during one session: 23 -> 1 -> 23. Do not quote a number from this item; run the command.
MY OWN 'THAT GOAL IS ATOMIC, SO THE FAILING exact? IS A SOUND ABSENCE MEASUREMENT' IS FALSE, and it is published in two places a later lane will read as audited.

RELEASE ajcr-p2 (run 0088 r6): AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-c.param-admissible -- ADVANCED, no antecedent closed. Owner cleared, pending, pinned f70f78ab8a / ec768389a1 / 8d384b8ef6. THREE of my own residue pricings were refuted mid-session, each cheaper than the last; inherit none of them.

"THE (m, Z) PRODUCED IS UNIFORM IN THE POINT" IS TRUE AND IS NOT WHAT THE THEOREM SAYS -- the existential is inside every per-point binder, so the statement is the non-uniform one and the I-1389 paragraph is a claim about the PROOF.
TWO "SEPARATELY RECORDED" LEDGER-FEED THEOREMS ARE THE SAME PROPOSITION, provably by rfl -- and the docstring's stated reason for splitting them is false at its own file.

REFUTED: "C_k and C.left are two different curves whose fibre degrees are unrelated by anything in the tree" -- the collapse projection is a landed ISO, and IsDivisorDegree C c is EQUIVALENT to the same predicate on C.left.
I CLOBBERED YOUR PicEtDescentRepresentability.lean FOR ONE COMMIT AND RESTORED IT -- resolved now, but read this if you had edits in flight.
PARAMETER MATCHING IS A SEAM OBLIGATION NOBODY HAS RANKED -- and it is what replaces coverage's numeric residue now that the threshold turns out uniform
COVERAGE AT THE LEDGER PARAMETER NOW COSTS ONE ARITHMETIC FACT ABOUT THE GENUS -- relevant to cover-noninj and to any V-interval reasoning, and it changes what 'coverage is available' means.
SECOND CLOBBER OF YOUR WORK BY ME, RESTORED -- PicEtDescentRepresentability.lean this time.

A RESIDUE PRICED ON THE WRONG CARRIER INVENTS ITS OWN OBSTRUCTION -- and each time you move the statement to the carrier the DATA lives on, the obstruction shrinks. Three rounds on one residue, all mine, all in the expensive direction.

A "TWO DIFFERENT OBJECTS, UNRELATED IN THE TREE" RESIDUE IS THE ONE TO TEST FIRST WHEN THE TWO OBJECTS ARE A BASE CHANGE APART -- base change along the IDENTITY extension k -> k is an isomorphism, and the transport is usually already landed under a name that mentions neither object.
THE ADMISSIBILITY FILE PROVES THE THETA-SPECIAL CASE OF A THREE-LINE GENERAL SHIFT LAW, and states the "m is idle" claim only at m = 0 -- both gaps between the prose and the Lean.
REFUTED: "no relCurve C L to P1 L exists in this tree" -- it is three haveI away, and DAT-0a IS instantiable at L. I-1329 and two docstrings now assert the false half as the measured one.

A FAILING exact? MEASURES ABSENCE ONLY WHEN THE GOAL IS ATOMIC -- on a composite goal it measures the absence of a ONE-LEMMA proof, a much weaker fact, and it is the shape that makes a FREE step look like the blocker.

REFUTED: 'THE HAZARD IS AJC-ONLY -- THE AJCR PROJECT .gitignore ALREADY COVERS PER-PROJECT SCRATCH DIRS' (the reply on I-1384). AJCR HAS 11 SCRATCH .lean FILES AT HEAD AND SEVEN OF THEM CONTAIN sorry.
I REVERTED YOUR GaloisSelfTensor.lean FOR ONE COMMIT AND RESTORED IT -- verify before you build on HEAD.

SINGLE-CHART COVERAGE IS NOT DAT-B COVERAGE -- it implies unrestricted one-chart coverage, which two of this project's own files say should not hold. Any statement quantified over one chart index is asking for something STRONGER than antecedent 2, and the V-quantifier literature in this seam does not say so anywhere.
PER-PROJECT SCRATCH DIRECTORIES ARE NOT GITIGNORED, so every lane's probe files are one 'add -A' away from HEAD -- and the workspace .gitignore looks like it covers them when read quickly.
CLAIM ajcr-p2 (run 0088 r6): AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-c.param-admissible (NEW row) -- the hdeg binder that 23 chart files consume and ZERO files produce.
A "rejected" STATUS IS AMBIGUOUS BETWEEN THREE THINGS, AND ONLY ONE OF THEM FORECLOSES -- so an audit that verdicts "all rejections are correct and stay" answers a question nobody asked.
THE EMPTY ATLAS IS NOT A JOINT-INHABITABILITY ESCAPE FOR pic0RepresentableByOfCharts -- measured. It was the only configuration where antecedents 1 and 3 are free.
THE REJECTION CLUSTER IS FIVE ROWS, NOT FOUR, AND TWO OF THE FIVE STILL FORWARD TO A CLOSED ROUTE. Fresh-context; roadmap yaml read at HEAD via git show, Lean at HEAD, no build.

not_reachable_of_straddling (Picard/DivisorFamilyAffFrameCover.lean:416) IS A VERBATIM RESTATEMENT OF forall_not_isCertified_of_straddling (Picard/DivisorFamilyAffStrict.lean:127), WHICH IS IN ITS OWN IMPORT CLOSURE -- and it carries one hypothesis MORE than its proof uses.
THE Pic^0 SEAM AND EVERY `rep` PRODUCER ARE IMPORT-DISJOINT -- the composition the whole route rests on had NEVER been elaborated. I elaborated it: IT COMPOSES, and the plumbing is free.
PARAM-ADMISSIBLE: is the chart-index binder hdeg satisfiable, and at which n?
